description: Let a finite-solution formula \(\varphi\) belong to \(p\). Suppose \((q_i)_{i\in I}\) lists all other complete types containing it, with finite \(I\), and choose \(\psi_i\in p\setminus q_i\). Then the specified refinement \(\varphi\land\bigwedge_i\psi_i\) has finite solution set and isolates \(p\) over \(\operatorname{Th}(M_A)\).
